purpose: Curated, small result artifacts (CSV/JSON/MD) suitable to commit to GitHub without LFS. Full results/ tree is ~2.3 GiB; do not commit everything.
gitignore_status: Root .gitignore: **/results/** then re-include 20260424 rerun subtree with negations for small Step4–7 paths. Excluded from git: step5 predictions csv+parquet (~330M+), __pycache__, and all other step4_models (DL/Graph/npy) under fs_a except integrated_step4_audit/.
alternatives_if_you_prefer_not_to_touch_: Copy the same small files into github_shared/exports/ and commit that folder (duplicate data, simple).
Attach a zip to a GitHub Release (good for 10–100s MiB).
Zenodo, S3, or institutional storage for the full 2.3 GiB tree.
